root_idea.summary: The root centers on holding something back, stopping its movement, or keeping it within bounds.
root_idea.development: From physical restraint, the lexical development extends to detention, self-restraint, retained water and water-control structures, and the permanent reservation of property. These related developments are not all meanings of the supplied Quranic verb.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form حَبَسَ rather than the imperfect QAC lemma يَحْبِسُ.

senses.definition: To hold back, restrain, confine, or detain a person or thing, preventing its movement, escape, release, or progress.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive verb. In the Quranic occurrences it denotes detaining people and holding something back; the construction in 5:106 refers to detaining two people after prayer. The same restraint relation can express withholding someone or something from a course, purpose, or desired object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To restrict or settle property upon a specified person, by will or another legal disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extended construction in which property is confined to a beneficiary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bequeath or dedicate an animal or other property permanently for the cause of God or religion, making it inalienable while its benefit is assigned to that cause.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal or pious endowment usage; the dedicated object is not subsequently sold, inherited, or given away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confine or restrain one another, each party restricting the other.
To restrain or hold oneself back; to confine oneself to a matter or withhold oneself from proceeding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive Form V construction, commonly used with عَلَى for restriction to something or with عَنْ for holding back from something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become confined, restricted, or limited, or to confine oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quasi-passive or reflexive Form VIII use; the related Form VII entry is referred to this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of urine, to become suppressed or retained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily use of the intransitive/reflexive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appropriate something to oneself, restricting it to one's exclusive possession; also, to constitute it a permanent ḥabīs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive or endowment-related extension of the Form VIII verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of confinement, such as a prison or jail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a location in which people or things are confined.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dam, barrier, basin, or other structure that confines water; also water collected and retained behind such a structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in water management and irrigation contexts, including barriers in channels and enclosed areas that retain water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of confinement, restriction, or limitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun denoting the condition of being held back or restricted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Difficulty or hesitation in speaking distinctly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for impeded or hesitant speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Confined, restricted, or limited; a person or thing held back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or resultative adjective and noun. It can also denote something characterized by being held or retained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal, property, land, or house permanently dedicated as an inalienable endowment for charitable or religious use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The endowed object remains itself unavailable for sale or inheritance while its benefit is assigned for the designated purpose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A jailer or person responsible for confinement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive occupational noun formed from the root of confinement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who confines, restrains, or retains; also something that holds or retains what is placed in it. حَابِسُ الْفِيلِ, “Restrainer of the Elephant,” is an epithet applied to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participle noun. The epithet alludes to the Quranic account of the elephant, while the retaining sense can describe a container or herbage that holds water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manger or stable for an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place noun for keeping an animal confined or housed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of livestock, remaining at the house rather than going out to pasture, as though restrained from grazing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive/reflexive participial use explicitly applied to camels kept at home.
